liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **White House Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [13]
- **Hide and Seak**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [13]
- **A Good Woman's Love**: rare: 13 archived performances [13]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2021-11-13.matrix** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 26 songs; 147 min [1]
- **billystrings2021-11-13.vwmule**: source not stated; 25 songs; 142 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]
- **billystrings2021-11-13.AKGCK61.Flac24**: source not stated; 26 songs; 147 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **billystrings2021-11-13.AKGCK61.Flac16**: source not stated; 26 songs; 147 min [8]
- **billystrings2021-11-13.4mic.flac24**: source not stated; 26 songs; 145 min [9]

## Around the show

- The show was sold out with no opening band, and attendees had to show proof of Covid-19 vaccination [2]
- Sold-out Saturday show with no opener, running about 8:30 to 11 PM; vaccination proof was required for entry [3]
- The show was sold out with no opening band, ran roughly 8:30 to 11 PM, and required proof of vaccination [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2021-11-13.matrix**: taped by Tapernate; transferred by Tapernate; source: see text file [1]
- **billystrings2021-11-13.vwmule**: taped by Alex Leary; transferred by Alex Leary; source: Microtech Gefell M21 > nBob actives > Sound Devices MixPre-6 (24/48) [2]. Also: Reviewer says the taper was named Alex, and they spoke with him before the show; Transferred from the MixPre-6 to an iMac, tracked in Sound Studio, and encoded to FLAC with xACT [2][10]
- **billystrings2021-11-13.AKGCK61.Flac24**: taped by Rich Stoler; transferred by Rich Stoler; source: AKG CK61 Card Mic's w c460B > TASCAM-DR-100MKIII (24/48kHz) [3]. Also: Mics were set up by the soundboard at twelve feet high; transfer went through Audacity with slight amplification, then CD Wave and Foobar2000 [3]
- **billystrings2021-11-13.AKGCK61.Flac16**: taped by Rich Stoler; transferred by Rich Stoler; source: AKG CK61 Card Mic's w c460B > TASCAM-DR-100MKIII (24/48kHz) [8]. Also: This 16-bit version of Rich Stoler's AKG CK61 recording was dithered in Audacity and is meant for burning to CD; Source was AKG CK61 mics with C460B into a TASCAM DR-100MKIII, placed twelve feet high near the soundboard [8]
- **billystrings2021-11-13.4mic.flac24**: taped by Peter Del Savio; transferred by Peter Del Savio; source: (4 mic mix) Neumann KM185's + AKG461's -> Sound Devices MixPre-6 (24/48) [9]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Worthpoint: [Billy Strings Anthem DC Poster One Drop Design Signed AP Washington Owen Murphy | #3929926900](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/billy-strings-anthem-dc-poster-one-3929926900) [14]
